Consabrum , i, n.,
I.a town of Hispania Tarraconensis, south of Toletum, now Consuegra, Itin. Anton. p. 446.—Hence, Con-saburensis , e, adj., of Consabrum, Inscr. Grut. 402, 5; 909, 14.—Plur. as subst.: Con-saburenses , ium, m., the inhabitants of Consabrum, Plin. 3, 3, 4, § 15; Front. Strat. 4, 5, 19.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
